factor_derivation.mean: rho=Psi D Psi^dagger, Psi_dot=-i H Psi, D fixed. Full PW rows remain on every frame.
factor_derivation.tangent: delta_rho=L Psi^dagger+Psi R. Ldot=-i(H L+deltaH Psi D); Rdot=i(R H+D Psi^dagger deltaH). R is an independent bra array, not L^dagger. deltaH need not be Hermitian, so its adjoint action is reconstructed using conjugate complex field/direction rather than identifying it with the ket drive.
factor_derivation.physical_derivative: Reconstruction MUST also include L Psi_dot^dagger and Psi_dot R. The resulting derivative is -i([H,delta_rho]+[deltaH,rho]). Leg derivatives alone are not the density derivative.
factor_derivation.ordered_source_AB: N*w_B*(I-rho) B rho, represented by ket=N*w_B*(B Psi-Psi D Psi^dagger B Psi)D and zero bra.
factor_derivation.ordered_source_BA: N*w_B*rho B(I-rho), represented by zero ket and bra=N*w_B*D*(B^dagger Psi-Psi D Psi^dagger B^dagger Psi)^dagger.
factor_derivation.population: No inverse D, no occupation-gap division, no population/degenerate-sector removal. Full complement enters B Psi and every subsequent full-row action.
factor_derivation.normalization: Mean uses w_s Tr(A rho). Collective readout uses w_s Tr(A X), X=sqrt(N)*delta rho, so electronic covariance is N sum_s w_s^2 CAR_s. Ionic y is canonical collective coordinate. N*w_s=1 ensures matching quantum mean/tangent commutator scaling for the explicit uniform modes.
